```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % intEnt "<!ELEMENT custom (#PCDATA)>">
  %intEnt;
]>
<root>
  <child>Test</child>
  <custom>Custom element defined via internal parameter entity</custom>
</root>
